objective: Convert SURAKSHA flood intelligence website to Next.js, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui with separate Three.js module, GSAP, and Framer Motion
acceptance_criteria: Next.js App Router project initialized with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS
shadcn/ui-inspired component architecture with modern dark-tech palette, refined typography, and glassmorphic surfaces

Three.js 3D Digital Twin extracted into a dedicated, modular file (components/three/DigitalTwinScene.tsx) preserving all features (terrain, procedural waves, station beacons, particles, tilt controls, surge simulation)
Framer Motion integrated for fluid transitions, page routing, interactive tilt cards, and modal feedback
GSAP integrated for timeline-driven telemetry animations and radar pulses
All public and authenticated routes implemented (Home, Platform, How it Works, Research, Alerts & Safety, Demo Lab, Citizen Portal, Operations / Admin Portal)
Backend proxy API routes (/api/flood/health, /api/flood/stations, /api/flood/scenarios/run) preserved for FastAPI backend interoperability
Next.js build (npm run build) passes with zero errors
non_goals: Do not drop or simplify the 3D Digital Twin or surge simulation
Do not break compatibility with SURAKSHA FastAPI backend endpoints
Do not remove legacy index.html without archiving as index.legacy.html
